tools.name: campaigner_get_account
tools.description: Return the Campaigner account name and the permissions this API key has (for example Campaigns_GetStats, Emails_Get). Use it first to see what the key can read. Campaigner API: GET /Ping.

tools.name: campaigner_get_database_columns
tools.description: List the custom subscriber fields (columns) defined in the account database. Use it before filtering subscribers by a field. Campaigner API: GET /Database.

tools.name: campaigner_get_database_column
tools.description: Return the details of one custom subscriber field by name. Campaigner API: GET /Database/{columnName}.

tools.name: campaigner_list_lists
tools.description: List all contact lists with their names, descriptions and active member counts. Campaigner API: GET /Lists.

tools.name: campaigner_get_list
tools.description: Return the details of one contact list. Campaigner API: GET /Lists/{listID}.

tools.name: campaigner_list_list_members
tools.description: Page through the subscribers of one contact list. Campaigner API: GET /Lists/{listID}/Members (PageSize, PageNumber, Since).

tools.name: campaigner_add_emails_to_list
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 100 email addresses to one contact list. Changes the customer's own list. Use it only for contacts who gave consent to email. Campaigner API: POST /Lists/{listID}/AddEmails. HTTP 400 can mean some addresses failed: read the Failures list.

tools.name: campaigner_remove_emails_from_list
tools.description: WRITE: remove up to 100 email addresses from one contact list. The contacts stop receiving that list's mail. Campaigner API: POST /Lists/{listID}/RemoveEmails.

tools.name: campaigner_list_campaigns
tools.description: List email campaigns in one status: active, sent, drafts, all, sending or scheduled. Campaigner API: GET /Campaigns, /Campaigns/Sent, /Campaigns/Drafts, /Campaigns/All, /Campaigns/Sending, /Campaigns/Scheduled.

tools.name: campaigner_get_campaign
tools.description: Return the details of one campaign. Campaigner API: GET /Campaigns/{campaignID}.

tools.name: campaigner_list_campaign_links
tools.description: List the tracked links in one campaign. Campaigner API: GET /Campaigns/{campaignID}/Links.

tools.name: campaigner_list_campaign_activity
tools.description: Page through one campaign's recipients, opens, clicks, removes, complaints, soft or hard bounces. Campaigner API: GET /Campaigns/{campaignID}/<activity> (PageSize, PageNumber, Since).

tools.name: campaigner_list_publications
tools.description: List the publications (subscription newsletters) in the account. Campaigner API: GET /Publications.

tools.name: campaigner_get_publication
tools.description: Return the details of one publication. Campaigner API: GET /Publications/{publicationID}.

tools.name: campaigner_list_publication_members
tools.description: Page through the subscribers of one publication. Campaigner API: GET /Publications/{publicationID}/Members (PageSize, PageNumber, Since).

tools.name: campaigner_list_sources
tools.description: List the sources (where subscribers joined) in the account. Campaigner API: GET /Sources.

tools.name: campaigner_list_subscribers
tools.description: Page through the subscribers in the account, optionally since a date. Campaigner API: GET /Subscribers (PageSize, PageNumber, Since).

tools.name: campaigner_get_subscriber
tools.description: Return one subscriber's record and status by email address. Campaigner API: GET /Subscribers/{email}.

tools.name: campaigner_get_subscriber_properties
tools.description: Return one subscriber's custom field values, lists and publications by email. Campaigner API: GET /Subscribers/{email}/Properties.

tools.name: campaigner_get_subscriber_history
tools.description: Return one subscriber's action history (subscribed, opened, clicked, workflow steps) by email. Campaigner API: GET /Subscribers/{email}/History.

tools.name: campaigner_list_bounces
tools.description: Page through bounced addresses: all, hard or soft bounces. Campaigner API: GET /Bounces, /Bounces/Hard, /Bounces/Soft (PageSize, PageNumber, Since).

tools.name: campaigner_list_suppression_lists
tools.description: List the suppression lists (addresses and domains never to email). Campaigner API: GET /SuppressionLists.

tools.name: campaigner_list_suppression_emails
tools.description: Page through the addresses in one suppression list. Campaigner API: GET /SuppressionLists/{suppressionListID}/Emails.

tools.name: campaigner_list_workflows
tools.description: List the automation workflows in the account. Campaigner API: GET /Workflows.

tools.name: campaigner_get_workflow_stats
tools.description: Return the statistics of one workflow. Campaigner API: GET /Workflows/{workflowID}/Stats.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: campaigner_add_emails_to_list, campaigner_remove_emails_from_list, campaigner_list_campaigns, campaigner_get_subscriber, campaigner_get_subscriber_properties, campaigner_get_subscriber_history, campaigner_list_suppression_lists, campaigner_list_suppression_emails · Private data: campaigner_get_account, campaigner_get_database_columns, campaigner_get_database_column, campaigner_list_lists, campaigner_get_list, campaigner_list_list_members, campaigner_add_emails_to_list, campaigner_remove_emails_from_list, campaigner_get_subscriber · Public sink: campaigner_add_emails_to_list, campaigner_remove_emails_from_list, campaigner_list_campaigns, campaigner_get_subscriber, campaigner_get_subscriber_properties, campaigner_get_subscriber_history, campaigner_list_suppression_lists · Destructive: campaigner_remove_emails_from_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: campaigner_add_emails_to_list, campaigner_remove_emails_from_list, campaigner_list_campaigns, campaigner_get_subscriber, campaigner_get_subscriber_properties, campaigner_get_subscriber_history, campaigner_list_suppression_lists, campaigner_list_suppression_emails · Private data: campaigner_get_account, campaigner_get_database_columns, campaigner_get_database_column, campaigner_list_lists, campaigner_get_list, campaigner_list_list_members, campaigner_add_emails_to_list, campaigner_remove_emails_from_list, campaigner_get_subscriber · Public sink: campaigner_add_emails_to_list, campaigner_remove_emails_from_list, campaigner_list_campaigns, campaigner_get_subscriber, campaigner_get_subscriber_properties, campaigner_get_subscriber_history, campaigner_list_suppression_lists · Destructive: campaigner_remove_emails_from_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
